Ruling: batch #4 items 1 / 2 · letters A / A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-23T11:29:31Z

Recorded by the director ruling thread 「待决策汇总」 (Claude Code project "Objectstack", account `os-elon-musk`). Batch doc: https://claude.ai/artifact/Ld4xLWTrTSuhQ7eu2uAbHd. The maintainer's one word covers the three recommendations named in the batch's 回批 line (「1A 2A 3B」或「同意」); item 3 (hotcrm release number) is recorded on hotcrm#2252. The ruling thread only records; the card thread and the owning seat execute.

**Item 1 — A (coordinator reads, seat claims, thread verifies).** This card's item 3 as written (branch named before the thread opens) is not possible: a project card thread's branch `claude/project-thread-<random>` is platform-assigned at thread creation (measured on PR #25385's own thread, A2; confirmed cross-session by the ruling thread and by the coordinator via `get_session(session_id)` → `session_context.outcomes[].git_repository.git_info.branches`, present before any push). Ruled shape: the coordinator reads the new thread's branch from its session record the moment it is spawned and hands it to the seat in the same stroke; the seat writes assignee + `pm:dispatched` + the `Claim:` naming that branch; the thread's first act stays 「verify the newest `Claim:` names my branch」 and it starts as soon as the claim is up; if the coordinator cannot read it, the thread reports its branch as today (fallback). The empty-branch probe push is dropped for card threads (the branch is platform-designated and every later push takes the harness route), which needs one line in `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` rule 1 — the seat widens the claim's file surface by that one file, same Tier S. Workload: `references/dispatch-runbook.md` 〈卡线程〉 L141–L142 edited in place (line-neutral, ≤120 bytes each, exact wording by the card thread) + 1 line in `os-dev.md`, as a follow-up commit on PR #25385; the `coordinator.md` pointer still waits for PR #25255 as the card foresees.

**Item 2 — A (direct sessions are summoned only).** PR #25385 deletes SKILL.md L70 「入座即建唯一自绑 cron Routine(`create_trigger`,`own_followup`)作默认唤醒」 as Routine-seat payment, which leaves a seat run as a plain direct session (neither a UI Routine nor a project thread; SKILL.md L74 「分诊席跑普通直连会话」) without a written wake rule (contract review 6358117147 ③-2). Ruled shape: a direct-session seat is summoned by hand like the 总监席 — it runs one round when called, ⛔ no self-wake, no Routine, not resident; PR subscription events still wake it. Workload: one clause added in place on SKILL.md L70 (「席位两形…」) or L74, line-neutral, same follow-up commit; no new line, no deletion elsewhere.

**Execution:** the card thread 项目承办席位形态 pushes the follow-up commit on PR #25385 (head now `7198a099`); `domain:skills` seat 2 re-reviews the new head at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER; landing still waits on the maintainer's own 「可以落地」 (Tier S).
